newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firmer, scramble for paraffinic grades.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firmer, scramble for paraffinic grades.

text.p: NWE naphtha was firmer on Wednesday, with the market for paraffinic grades tight, traders said.
"There's very good demand for everything from open spec upwards," said one trader.
A trading house bidding at around $229 a tonne cif NWE for for pipeline spec material had still not found a cargo by the end of the London day.
The paper market was also firmer, with Nov swaps climbing $3 to trade at $221 a tonne cif NWE.
